title: Modern DimStorage
body:
Tired of DimStorage's outdated textures clashing with modern Minecraft?​​ This resource pack completely ​​revamps every texture​​ in the mod to a vanilla-like 16x16 resolution​​, adding refined details for seamless visual harmony with newer game versions.
![Simply showing the modified texture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/50804b3c97ceb9bcef9cc96404b4da5cc16ed9c9.png)
